clean_repro.observed: HTTP 200 OK returned for invalid negative desiredCount (-1). Collection creation succeeded without validation error.
clean_repro.evidence_cmd: curl -X POST 'http://localhost:18080/v1/schema' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"class": "TestNeg", "shardingConfig": {"desiredCount": -1}}' -> HTTP 200 OK (expected: 4xx error)

violated_assumptions: Assumption: API validates numeric range constraints at schema creation boundary. Violated: No validation for desiredCount >= 1.

contract_refs: Physical constraint: shard count must be >= 1 for operational database (cannot have zero or negative shards)

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: ParseConfig() -> optionalIntFromMap('desiredCount') -> NO VALIDATION -> setDefault() uses invalid negative value directly
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:Config.validate()函数只检查key/strategy/function字段,完全不检查desiredCount范围。ParseConfig()直接通过optionalIntFromMap接受任意整数值(包括负数和零),无>=1校验。

falsification.observed: HTTP 404 Not Found - collection created with desiredCount=-1 doesn't actually exist, proving internal failure occurs despite 200 OK response. This is Type1 IllegalSuccess: API reports success but operation fails silently.
falsification.evidence_cmd: curl -X GET 'http://localhost:18080/v1/schema/TestNeg' -> HTTP 404 (proving collection doesn't exist despite creation returning HTTP 200)

excluded: Not a concurrent/race issue (single request test)
Not an environment issue (reproducible on fresh container)
Not a misunderstanding of API semantics (shardingCount clearly should be >= 1)

cognition_match.developer_quote: Parameter validation gaps at API boundaries - what developers consider bugs
cognition_match.note: 命中bug_shapes.json中的BS-004模式:Parameter Validation Issues in Request Parsing。developer_cognition.json明确指出'Parameter validation gaps at API boundaries'是维护者认为的bug类型。

verdicts.rationale: POST /schema接受非法的shardingConfig.desiredCount=-1值并返回HTTP 200 OK,但实际集合创建失败(后续GET返回404)。源码分析显示ParseConfig()函数的validate()方法完全不检查desiredCount范围,只检查key/strategy/function字段。这是典型的参数验证漏洞,违反了基本的物理约束(shard count必须>=1)。维护者明确将'Parameter validation gaps at API boundaries'列为bug类型,符合BS-004模式。
